held.headline: Kremlin Places Russian Operations of Nestlé and Auchan Under Temporary Administration
held.reason: Consequential corporate/geopolitical development, but this cycle did not establish a second independent newsroom confirmation plus a genuinely relevant republication-cleared photograph with verified creator, licence and original dimensions. Held rather than publishing from one report or using a generic image.

held.headline: Taiwan Conducts First Joint Military Drills Combining Attack Drones and Conventional Weapons
held.reason: Consequential Indo-Pacific security development with Philippine regional relevance, but armed-security coverage requires stronger corroboration and the cycle did not establish a rights-cleared event photograph with complete creator/licence/dimensions metadata. Held.

held.headline: Iran Says It Struck Oil Tanker in Strait of Hormuz
held.reason: High-risk armed-conflict and maritime-security story. The tanker strike is an Iranian claim and requires the existing human-review safeguard plus independently verified image rights before publication. Held without presenting the claim as independently confirmed.

held.headline: Yemen Fighting Displaces at Least 112,000, UN Migration Agency Says
held.reason: Consequential humanitarian/conflict development affecting a strategic shipping corridor, but armed-conflict coverage remains subject to high-risk review and this cycle did not establish a fully rights-cleared relevant photograph. Held.

held.headline: Floods and Landslides Kill at Least Four and Inundate More Than 16,000 Homes in Vietnam
held.reason: Consequential regional disaster, but the cycle did not establish an independently reusable real photograph with verified creator, licence and original dimensions. Held rather than publishing without the required image-rights record.

held.headline: Zelenskyy Launches Carpathian Eight Regional Trade and Security Initiative
held.reason: Independently corroborated and consequential, but the security initiative is embedded in active-war coverage and no republication-cleared summit photograph with complete rights metadata was verified in this cycle. Held.

audit.note: One lower-risk story cleared editorial verification, image-rights verification and CMS publication. Other qualifying developments are explicitly held for the listed safeguard or image-rights blockers; none is silently omitted or claimed live.
